bagPolicy.summary: Globe Life Field enforces a clear bag policy to ensure fan safety and expedite entry. Approved bags include clear bags up to 12” x 6” x 12” and small clutches no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”.
allowed: Clear Bags (Plastic, vinyl or PVC) up to 12” x 6” x 12”
Small Clutch Bags/Wallets no larger than 6.5” x 4.5”
Seat cushions without pockets, zippers or concealable areas up to 18” wide
bagPolicy.note: Diaper bags and medical bags are exceptions.

parking.note: Globe Life Field is in the Arlington Entertainment District with lettered lots shared across the Rangers/AT&T Stadium complex, sold prepaid by event. Parking is cashless and prices vary; lots open a few hours before first pitch. There is no rail service, so driving or rideshare is typical.

rideshare.note: Uber is widely available in Arlington 24 hours a day. Pickup and drop-off is on Nolan Ryan Expressway between Randol Mill Road and Road to Six Flags.

concessions.note: Globe Life Field offers a variety of food and beverage options, including a lively Beer Garden with local and popular beers. Highlights include Bridges Grille's Bacon Wrapped Hot Dog and Cadillac Diner's Chili Cheese Hot Dog. Coop & Kennel Pub features Pastrami Fry and Crispy Fried Chicken Sub, while Golden Spike Chophouse serves classic comfort foods.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: A dedicated sensory room is located inside the Toyota Southwest Entrance, across from Section 113. Sensory bags are available at Guest Services on the Main Concourse behind Section 101.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is permitted at Globe Life Field at specific doors and all public entries from the time doors open until the start of the game.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Call 972-RANGERS x1, go online to www.texasrangers.com or visit the Southeast Ticket Office located on the southside of Globe Life Field near the SeatGeek Southeast Entry.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The shuttle is available when lots open (generally 30 minutes before gates open) and continues for approximately 30 minutes after the game ends.
